description: Ultra Mini Tiny PC is a compact yet powerful business-class mini desktop PC, designed to deliver reliable performance while saving desk space. Powered by an InteI Core 6th Generation processor, this Tiny PC is ideal for office work, business applications, online tasks, and everyday computing needs. Equipped with Fast RAM and a fast SSD, the system ensures smooth multitasking, quick boot times, and efficient data access. The Small Form Factor (Tiny design) makes it perfect for workspaces with limited space, retail counters, offices, or home setups. Pre-installed with Win 11 Pro and Ms office 2021 preactivate, it offers enhanced security, business features, and professional usability. With multiple connectivity options like USB ports, DisplayPort/VGA (via adapter), Ethernet, and support for external displays, the Tiny is both versatile and dependable. Built with trusted durability standards, this mini PC is a smart choice for users looking for performance, efficiency, and space-saving design in one reliable machine.
